name: notes
description: Fast, simple notes with search and auto-save.
author: Swirl
title: Notes
tagline: Write it down. It saves itself.
long: A quick notes app for SwirlOS. Every note is a plain .txt file in /home/user/Notes, so you can open them anywhere.\nCtrl+N new note, Ctrl+F search, Ctrl+Z / Ctrl+Y undo and redo, Ctrl+V paste, Ctrl+D (twice) deletes the note. Click anywhere to place the cursor. Notes save automatically a moment after you stop typing.
